question: Who was the first Deputy Chairman of Planning Commission of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Gulzarilal Nanda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gulzarilal Nanda** was the first **Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission** of India.
 
• He was a prominent **Indian politician** and also served as the **interim Prime Minister of India** twice: once in **1964** after the death of Jawaharlal Nehru and again in **1966** after the death of Lal Bahadur Shastri.
 
• Gulzarilal Nanda was deeply involved in the formation of policies related to **labour welfare** and **economic planning**.
 
• The Planning Commission was established in **1950** by the Government of India to focus on the country's economic and social development.
 
• As the Deputy Chairman, Nanda played a significant role in shaping the initial stages of India's **Five-Year Plans**.
 
• He was known for his contributions to India's economic policies and his work in the **industrial and labour sectors**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chintaman Deshmukh**__

 __
 
• **Chintaman Dwarkanath Deshmukh** was the first Indian to become the **Governor of the Reserve Bank of India**.
 
• He was also a member of the **Constituent Assembly** that framed the Indian Constitution.
 
• He served as the **Union Finance Minister** from **1950 to 1956**.
 
• He played a key role in India's economic development during the early years of independence.
 
 
 
• **NR Pillai**__
 
 
• **N R Pillai** served as the first **Cabinet Secretary** of India.
 
• He was instrumental in establishing the framework for **civil services** in India post-independence.
